title: The Intercepted Dispatch
logline: When a neutral packet-boat line has its dispatch runner gunned down in transit, the station dispatcher hires an outsider to hunt the raiders and retrieve the encrypted treaty mail.

roles.description: Oversees the system courier relay docks; exhausted, chain-smoker demeanor, deeply entangled in station fuel arrears.
A heavily modified gun-skiff flown by privateers who ambushed the scheduled mail courier.
A ruthless fringe raiding network intercepting unprotected courier runs across unmonitored lanes.
An alliance of independent drillers whose confidential peace treaty dispatches were stolen in transit.
The central pressurized hub where courier ships refuel and swap encrypted mail canisters.
An unlit navigation beacon in a dense debris belt where the raiders stashed the intercepted mail pod.

public_situation: Scheduled mail service across {system} ground to a halt after an independent courier boat was destroyed near {role:derelict_waypoint}.
private_truth: {role:station_dispatcher} sold the mail boat's flight coordinates to {role:raider_syndicate} to settle the hub's unpaid fuel bills, expecting them to steal only cargo rather than slaughter the crew.

beats.public_change: Armed raider pickets establish an interdiction cordon around the primary jump relay lane.

missions.reason: She needs the raider picket vessels around the transit corridor destroyed before local traffic flees the system and freezes station revenues.
missions.private_fact: She leaked the patrol timetable to the raiders on encrypted channels and now fears the corsairs will use the comms logs to blackmail her.

beats.public_change: The miners coalition threatens to suspend all system ore exports unless their stolen treaty packet is recovered.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to hunt down the raider flagship and retrieve the encrypted mail pod before the corsairs crack the coalition's cryptographic seal.
missions.private_fact: The pod contains proof that the coalition agreed to secret concessions that would bankrupt independent haulers.

beats.public_change: Coalition delegates assemble at the relay hub demanding custody of the recovered dispatch canister.

missions.reason: She wants the mail pod handed directly to her in person at the relay hub rather than routed through standard customs intake.
missions.private_fact: She intends to erase the dispatch registry records of the ambush before the coalition leadership inspects the canister.

player_choice.prompt: With the encrypted dispatches in hand, the pilot can deliver them quietly to the compromised dispatcher, hand them to the miners coalition, or turn them over to system inspectors.

options.label: Deliver the pod quietly to the station dispatcher
Hand the unedited mail pod directly to the miners coalition

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the recovered mail pod directly to the miners coalition.
resolutions.summary: {role:miners_coalition} secures their diplomatic dispatches. The dispatcher's route sale is exposed, forcing her resignation and rupturing {role:raider_syndicate}'s grip.

consequences.public_summary: A freelance pilot recovered the stolen treaty dispatches from raiders and broke the courier blockade.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands the mail pod to the station dispatcher for a private fee.
resolutions.summary: {role:station_dispatcher} buries the registry records and settles the station fuel debt. Courier runs resume under armed escort, though the corsairs remain at large.

resolutions.reached_by: The mail pod is shattered during the skirmish with the corsair flagship.
resolutions.summary: The diplomatic dispatches are obliterated in vacuum. Mistrust flares between {role:miners_coalition} and station authorities, stalling negotiations indefinitely.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot ignores the contract or the delivery is refused.
resolutions.summary: {role:raider_syndicate} dominates the transit lane. Independent courier services abandon the route entirely, leaving fringe stations cut off from regular mail.

loose_threads.detail: The courier pod's encryption keycard bears an official seal for a communications firm that was liquidated six months ago.
Docking berthing fees for the destroyed mail skiff were paid two weeks in advance by an offshore holding syndicate.
A recurring encrypted burst on the emergency beacon channel matches the pulse frequency of an unlisted corporate scout.

radio_hooks: Scheduled mail packet overdue at {role:relay_hub_seven}; freight insurance rates jump ten percent.
{role:miners_coalition} warns that disruption of dispatch runs threatens upcoming treaty talks.
Unidentified armed skiffs reported prowling transit beacons near {role:derelict_waypoint}.

voice_direction.station_dispatcher: Speaks in raspy, hurried tones with frequent pauses to check background monitors. Deflects questions about fuel bills.
